trickyParts: The live write validates the same tree twice: pmdoc.SetBlockAttributes' own out.Validate() (retype.go:127) and pmdoc.Update's want.Validate() (update.go:22). Removing either alone leaves the test green, and removing both makes the room record the value and refuse its own document afterwards, which is a different behaviour. The test therefore asserts the refusal is the value's (pmdoc.ErrSchema and not docs.ErrDocSchema), and the red-before that isolates it removes the ask arm of validateBlockPointerValues rather than a validator call.

The test needs newTestServer rather than blockIndexHandler: refuseBlockPointers reads each target's type from the block index in the write's own transaction, so the document service under test must be the one the handlers write through (deps.Docs).
deviations: The architect's acceptance asked for red-before by removing out.Validate() at pmdoc/retype.go:127. That cannot hold on this path, for the double validation above; the green result is recorded and the refusal is isolated two other ways instead, both red.
